recentItems.title: It’s GTL Forever. Jersey Shore Family Vacation Returns for Its Final Season May 7 | Official Trailer
recentItems.description:
They came to the Shore as strangers and became family for life.

From unforgettable vacations and iconic moments to growing families and major life changes, the crew is back together for the final season of Jersey Shore Family Vacation.

This season has everything: the roast session, surprises, tears, new beginnings, family dinners, wild antics, and the kind of moments that remind us why this cast has meant so much to so many for so long. And yes… there may even be a little fist pumping along the way.

The family is back together and the chaos is just as good as ever. Don’t miss the final season premiere on Jerzday, May 7 at 8PM ET on MTV.
